title: Encounters by terrain
summary: Random encounters as short text for six kinds of terrain, with numbers that roll themselves. Some only happen at night.

tables.name: Encounter: plains and roads
rows: [[1d4+1]] bandits with a rope across the road, hoping for a quick toll.
A merchant caravan of [[1d3+1]] wagons, guarded and nervous, glad of company.
A lone knight on a tired horse, looking for someone to challenge or someone to help.
[[2d6]] wild dogs trailing the party, slowly closing in.
A tax collector with two guards, a ledger and no sense of humor.
A herd of wild horses crosses the road and leaves a cloud of dust.
A group of [[1d6+2]] farmers with pitchforks, chasing something into the corn.
A bored patrol of [[1d4+2]] soldiers who check everything twice.
A traveling healer with a cart of bottles and a bad cough.
A burned out wagon by the roadside, still warm, with fresh tracks leading away.

rows.text: [[1d4+2]] riders without banners wait in the dark by the road, silent, with no fire.
A bright morning, and a band of [[1d6+2]] pilgrims asks the party to escort them to the next town.

tables.name: Encounter: forest
rows: A pack of [[1d4+2]] wolves, thin and wary, watching from between the trees.
A boar with a grudge and a very short temper, between the party and the path.
[[1d3+1]] poachers with a net, a cart and a story about being lost.
A hermit who offers tea and warns against going further north.
A tangle of huge spider webs across the path, and something stirring in the leaves above.
A druid and [[1d3]] animal companions, studying the party before deciding what to say.
A lumber crew of [[2d4]] with an overturned wagon and a trapped ox.
A shy fey creature who offers a bargain that sounds too good.
A bear cub alone on the path and no sign of its mother. Yet.
A burned clearing with a ring of stones and fresh footprints leading out.

rows.text: [[1d4+1]] goblins with torches and bad plans, sneaking along the edge of the trail.
Something very large moves through the trees in the dark, slowly, and then stops to listen.

tables.name: Encounter: hills and mountains
rows: A flock of goats and a shepherd who wants to talk about the weather for a very long time.
[[1d4+1]] hill raiders who like their ambush spots and know every ledge.
A lone giant eagle perched on a rock, studying the party.
A cave mouth with warm air coming out and a bear's footprints going in.
A band of [[1d6+1]] miners with a stuck cart and a story about what is further down.
A rockfall of loose stones with the sound of something moving behind it.
[[1d3]] ogres arguing over a stolen sheep, not yet aware of the party.
A wandering monk who offers to guide the party across a tricky pass for a small gift.
A thin trail of smoke from a hidden valley, with the faint sound of a hammer.
A traveling trader with a mule, overloaded with goods and out of breath.

rows.text: A pair of eyes reflects the light of the fire from above, on a ledge, and does not move.
A cold wind brings the howl of something big, far above. It does not sound like wind.

tables.name: Encounter: swamp
rows: A gang of [[1d4+2]] bog bandits poling flat boats through the reeds.
A giant leech the size of a dog in a pool the party has to cross.
A witch's hut on stilts with a lantern in the window and a pot on the fire.
A hunter on a raft who offers to guide the party for a fair price, and means it.
A pack of [[2d4]] large rats on a floating log, heading the same way.
A will o' the wisp that dances ahead, always just off the path.
A drowned wagon, half sunk, with something shiny under the mud.
A herd of swamp deer startled into flight by something upstream.
A lone frog the size of a barrel that stares at the party and then goes under.
A mist that smells of rot, thick enough to lose a companion in.

rows.text: Pale lights drift between the trees and call out in a voice that sounds like a friend.
The air is heavy with insects that bite and do not stop, and the party must rest soon.

tables.name: Encounter: coast
rows: A smugglers' boat pulled up on a hidden beach, with [[1d4+1]] crew and a lot of crates.
A shipwreck on the rocks with a handful of survivors waving from the shore.
A fishing village that does not welcome strangers, with every door closed.
A tide pool crowded with something that is too big for it.
A lone lighthouse keeper who has not seen another person in months and cannot stop talking.
A pirate scout in a small boat who pretends to be a fisherman.
A sea cave exposed by the low tide, with something glinting at the back.
A pod of dolphins playing in the shallows, followed by a very large shadow.
A beachcomber with a cart full of driftwood who knows where the best finds wash ashore.
A group of [[1d4+2]] gulls following the party in the hope of food, loudly.

rows.text: A faint light flashes out at sea three times, then twice, then nothing.
A thick sea fog rolls in with the tide and hides the cliff edge.

tables.name: Encounter: desert
rows: A caravan of [[1d3+2]] camels and a guide who knows the wells and sells that knowledge dearly.
A dust devil that dances across the dunes, harmless but unnerving.
A group of [[1d4+2]] bandits on fast horses who know the desert better than anyone.
A half buried statue with a worn face and an inscription that nobody can read.
A dry well with a rope that still holds, and the sound of wings far below.
A lone traveler on foot who asks for water and gives a very vague answer to every question.
A swarm of scorpions the color of sand around a dry bush.
A caravan trail marked with white bones that look very old and very large.
A mirage of a city on the horizon that does not go away when the party blinks.
A sandstorm on the horizon, a brown wall that moves fast.

rows.text: The desert grows cold. A clear sky and a faint glow in the sand where something shifts beneath.
The heat is brutal. Every creature is in the shade, and so is whoever is watching the party.
